description: This file defines interfaces and classes for message channels using Azure Storage Queues, including methods for creating send and receive channels, sending messages, and waiting for messages within a distributed testing framework.

classes.name: SendChannel
classes.description: Implements the ISendChannel interface, responsible for sending messages to a queue and receiving acknowledgments.

classes.name: ReceiveChannel
classes.description: Implements the IReceiveChannel interface, responsible for receiving messages from a queue and sending acknowledgments.

classes.name: Channels
classes.description: Provides static methods to create send and receive channels, and a utility method to wait for messages from a queue.

methods.name: SendMessages
methods.description: Sends a list of server messages to the write queue and waits for acknowledgment messages from the read queue.

methods.name: WaitForMessage
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for a message of type T from the queue, deleting the message once received.

methods.name: SendAck
methods.description: Creates and sends an acknowledgment message for a received server message.

methods.name: CreateSendChannel
methods.description: Creates and initializes a send channel with specified cluster ID and queue URI or service client.

methods.name: CreateReceiveChannel
methods.description: Creates and initializes a receive channel with specified server name, cluster ID, and queue URI or service client.
